wants.topic: Historical nostalgia framing of Hindu festivals ('100 साल पहले 1926 में [Festival] कैसे मनाया जाता था?')
wants.evidence: The Divine Journey achieved massive view spikes with 100-year-ago festival retrospectives: Chhath Puja (64.8x vsNormal), Dhanteras (51.56x vsNormal), and Diwali (43.91x vsNormal).

wants.topic: Unusual and humorous human-divine interactions involving Lord Shiva (e.g., Yamraj seeing Shiva sweep, old woman chasing Shiva with a broom)
wants.evidence: Shri Leela Charitam dominated with Shiva sweeping before Yamraj (22.64x vsNormal), old woman chasing Shiva (11.87x vsNormal), and a swindler trying to cheat Shiva in Kashi (6.04x vsNormal).

wants.topic: Festival-tied Vrat Kathas with complete Puja Vidhi and dramatic human story elements (e.g., 7 brothers breaking sister's fast)
wants.evidence: FaKT Dharmik Katha scored high on Tulsi Vivah katha (11.9x vsNormal), Amla Navami (8.12x vsNormal), and Karwa Chauth 7 brothers story (7.55x vsNormal).

gaps: 100-year historical documentary-style retrospectives applied to major temple traditions and lesser-known regional festivals (e.g., 100 years ago Jagannath Rath Yatra or Mahakumbh).
Richly animated/narrated lesser-known Shiv Leela stories highlighting Mahadev's innocence (Bholenath) and playful interactions with everyday villagers.
saturated: Generic chapter-by-chapter recitations without dramatic storytelling (e.g., Kartik Maas Mahatmya Adhyay 3 at 0.01x vsNormal).
Standard weekly vrat kathas without novel angles (e.g., generic Mangalwar Vrat Katha at 0x vsNormal).
Repetitive short summaries of well-known myth origins (e.g., Papankusha Ekadashi or why Vishnu turned to stone at 0.03x-0.05x vsNormal).
Generic background Bhajans without compelling visual storytelling (Divine Soul India videos staying near 1x vsNormal).
